evidence_limitations: Raw views are affected by impressions, upload age, packaging, release timing, and suggested distribution, so this comparison does not isolate premise causality.
The categorical gap is large and consistent enough to set a temporary premise prior, not a permanent genre law.

The Anti-Simp and Goddess of Death winners show that supernatural or identity mechanics can work when the human status fantasy is immediately legible; the negative signal is abstract rank-ladder progression, not fantasy itself.

distribution_context.interpretation: Ads are not supported as the primary cause of the August watch-time decline because viewing remained at the pre-ad level for the first three monetized days.

shorts_contamination.rule: Exclude Shorts from every longform premise, retention, and duration comparison.

derived_observations.working_thesis: This audience currently buys recognizable status reversal more reliably than abstract power progression.

active_test.default_lane: A personally legible modern betrayal followed by one simple numerical or impossible advantage that compounds into familiar money, ownership, career, business, property, influence, reputation, or skill proof.
suppressed_as_default: crystals used as a rank ladder
allowed_challengers: Identity comedy with an instantly understandable corrective mechanic.
Supernatural romance with a concrete human betrayal and visible social reversal.
Isekai or reincarnation only when the transported condition creates a one-breath human movie rather than a rank ladder.
active_test.selection_rule: Prefer a familiar social or financial receipt a cold viewer can value immediately. Do not select abstract rank progression unless the operator explicitly requests it or new measured evidence overturns this cohort result.
active_test.package_shape_rule: Treat asset-theft-plus-unit-multiplier as a reliable floor, not the whole channel. In the next three-upload slate, use that skeleton no more than twice and reserve one slot for a materially different, evidence-backed identity-comedy, hidden-status, supernatural-romance, or equivalent challenger.
active_test.rollback_rule: Reassess after ten longform selections using impression-normalized CTR, APV, AVD, traffic source, subscriber status, duration cohort, and packaging quality rather than raw views alone.

matched_ad_test.decision_metric: Subscriber APV relative to the prior 18.3 percent level and current 11.5 percent level, plus ad-aligned local retention drops around the exact three insertions.
matched_ad_test.within_video_control: At 24h, 72h, and 7d, attempt to capture audience_retention by elapsedVideoTimeRatio and compare each insertion-centered drop with equal-width adjacent segments. This local control is premise-independent, but an aligned cliff remains evidence of possible ad friction rather than proof of total causal impact.
matched_ad_test.reason: Duration mix and ad load remain confounded at the whole-video level.
